state: implemented-and-offline-verified; actual desktop account acceptance pending

original.request: pixiv 작가명, 그룹명, 태그 전체 번역본. 호버에서 가능하면 한국어 번역, 고유명사는 최소한 영어 발음.

decisions: One display-only glossary/reading pipeline for Pixiv tag groups, cards, creators, title, detail, reader and related works. Original labels, IDs, canonical searches, ordering, Ctrl/Shift, tabs, favorites and downloads remain unchanged.

Prefer bounded same-response official Korean tag translations. Otherwise use the existing Korean glossary (7280 entries) with exact official English aliases, then official English/romaji. Keep translation distinct from pronunciation.
Supplement common Japanese tags with a small explicit Korean alias dictionary. Do not substitute speculative translations for creator/group/work proper names.

Kana reading and lazy local Japanese morphological reading supply romanization when official text is absent. Label dictionary-derived Kanji readings as estimated; unknown readings are explicitly unavailable, never fabricated or reported as a complete Pixiv-wide corpus.

No bulk crawling, paid provider, online machine translation, cookie export, account write or metadata sent to another service. Local reading dictionaries are bundled, loaded only on deliberate hover/focus in one disposable worker, bounded by text/queue/cache/time limits and released when idle. No analysis on every card render.

No global account-content translation cache or persisted browsing history. Work-owned official tag hints persist only with the existing explicit local favorite/download record. Legacy records deserialize without hints. Do not edit stored albums or filename/manifest identity.

Validate untrusted translation schemas, exact tag joins, Unicode lengths/control characters and field count. Plain text rendering only. Account/privacy/current-surface fences remain; privacy removes tooltip content and cancels pending readings.

Hover/focus tooltip is compact, clamped to the viewport, does not move the card or steal clicks/keyboard shortcuts. Preserve existing inline favorite-tag translations. Latest request supersedes earlier favorite-only translation scope.
No invented Pixiv group taxonomy: group names contained in ordinary metadata use the same reading component; unsupported standalone group entities are not fabricated.

Preserve staged changes and the concurrent Pixiv discovery batch. No commit, push, release, user-media cleanup or process termination. Native restart only after a fresh safe idle check, through the existing normal path. Actual app acceptance remains separate from fixtures/builds.
acceptance: Official ko/en/romaji projection for exact canonical tags in home/search/work/detail, malformed/oversize/privacy/guest boundaries and old saved-record compatibility
Korean glossary preference, proper-name non-translation, kana and Kanji estimated reading, unknown Unicode preservation and bounded worker failure/timeout/cancellation
All metadata surfaces show the same hover behavior without changing click/selection/return/download state
Hidden/private/unmounted surfaces and rapid target changes cannot display stale readings
Narrow/1920x1080 tooltip geometry and long-text wrapping, no new bulk network traffic or initial dictionary load
Focused frontend/native regressions, typecheck and builds; actual desktop validation or clearly documented pending acceptance
limitations: Pixiv metadata is open-ended, not a finite downloadable all-name translation corpus.
Dictionary pronunciation is not confirmation of a creator's chosen reading.
No arbitrary title-to-Korean machine translation service is configured.
Real account/native desktop hover acceptance remains unverified; isolated browser fixtures are explicitly not represented as actual account verification.
